scope: Read-only audit of Supabase project identity, runtime bindings, permission boundaries, and staging isolation
sourceOfTruthRules: A reference from source code does not prove a live connected Supabase project or secret binding.
A connected project alone does not prove the running Vercel production or preview environment points to it.
Vercel Preview deployment isolation is NOT the same as an isolated staging database or separate DB roles.
Never connect non-production fixtures to an actual production DB without dedicated least-privilege credentials.
No real-money auction, seller payout, or authoritative bid enabled by this audit.

projects.name: enchev-auctions
projects.note: Candidate connected project contains demo auction tables and other systems; no real-money authoritative production DB status has been proved.

liveReadOnlyFindings.finding: Accessible Enchev project reports zero development branches. A separate staging project was not returned by available connected project list.
liveReadOnlyFindings.resolution: Owner provisions and verifies distinct staging Supabase project and least-privilege roles; check via read-only metadata before migrations.

liveReadOnlyFindings.finding: Governance project exists in repository configuration, but the connected Supabase account received permission denied on get_project.
liveReadOnlyFindings.resolution: Authorized owner confirms project status/role grants; no cross-project data access assumed.

liveReadOnlyFindings.finding: Vercel environment metadata listing denied 403; preview/production Supabase target refs cannot be independently verified.
liveReadOnlyFindings.resolution: Authorized Vercel project administrator checks target project IDs and scoped variable names without exposing secret values.

liveReadOnlyFindings.finding: Available database contains Enchev demo, SoulFlame DPP, Calendar and DAVID tables. All 28 public tables report RLS enabled, but RLS alone is not proof of tenant-safe access.
liveReadOnlyFindings.resolution: Document table and function allowlists, verify cross-tenant RLS and service-role boundaries on separate staging before launch.

liveReadOnlyFindings.finding: Read-only catalog query shows some public SECURITY DEFINER functions callable by anon/authenticated for DAVID and calendar domains; auction bid RPCs were not shown as executable by those roles.
liveReadOnlyFindings.resolution: Owning teams review affected functions and advisory WARN findings; no grant or function changes as part of D003.

liveReadOnlyFindings.finding: Supabase Security Advisor reports leaked-password protection disabled.
liveReadOnlyFindings.resolution: Project administrator reviews Auth security settings before real customers.

liveReadOnlyFindings.finding: Supabase located in Frankfurt eu-central-1; prior Vercel production deployment reports iad1 region.
liveReadOnlyFindings.resolution: Measure server-to-DB latency, consider deployment region and data processing geography; do not change blindly.

gateChecks.requirement: Actual production auction DB project identified and linked to running production runtime
Governance project role verified without using it as real-auction authority
Separate staging DB project/branch and isolated data confirmed
Distinct staging/production least-privilege service roles verified without viewing secrets
Migration history and public table RLS audited on accessible Enchev project
No privileged credential exposed in source files or audit artifact
Known Supabase advisors and public function grants logged for review

allowedNextActions: Provision isolated staging with owner-approved billing
Record independent CI and role evidence
Run D003 acceptance only after all mandatory gates
forbiddenActions: Activate real-money payments or authoritative bids
Auto-set D003 done based on static JSON
